latestVersion.changelog:
Trimmer Ezgif 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Upload MP4, GIF, WebM, or AVI videos (up to 200MB) for fast AI-powered trimming and export.
- Tell it exactly which sections to cut (e.g., "trim the first 10 seconds and last 5 seconds")—no manual sliders needed.
- Download your result as a 1080p MP4 optimized for content creators.
- Automatically manages session and backend connectivity with free credits if needed.
- Supports workflows for quick edits, batch processing, or iterative trimming.
- Clear error handling and support for various file types and formats.
